text:
Aria: FYI kicking off a short "admin-claim-scrub" to validate owner claims and capture a KMS grant trail for SOC evidence. 7-day window.
Ben: Nice. Quick scope?
Aria: Prod/staging IAM roles with last-used > 150 days OR owner tag missing. svcaccts included.
Kai: KMS caveat: if role appears as a Grantee we need to snapshot grants before any IAM change. otherwise we lose proof.
Ramal: agree. plan: (1) owner finder -> list -> (2) export grant snapshots -> (3) notify -> (4) 72h justification -> (5) remediate svcaccts.
Aria: exact snapshot command I'll run: `aws kms list-grants --key-id $K --query "Grants[?GranteePrincipal=='arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/$ROLE']" --output json > /tmp/$ROLE-$K-grants.json` then `aws s3 cp /tmp/$ROLE-$K-grants.json s3://sec-evidence/admin-claim-scrub/`
Ben: Add cloudtrail slice too. `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=$ROLE --start-time 2024-01-01 --end-time $(date -u +%FT%TZ)`
KeyBot: Created ticket SEC-410: admin-claim-scrub. evidence bucket path: s3://sec-evidence/admin-claim-scrub/SEC-410/
AuditBot: Attached initial iam-diff and cloudtrail-slice to SEC-410.
Kai: Tooling note: I'll run `./tools/find_ownerless_roles --days 150 > claims.txt` then `./tools/check_cross_bindings --input claims.txt > bindings.txt` to catch Vault/GCP/k8s bindings.
Ramal: For keys tagged `sensitive=true` we must escalate to KeyOps before any revoke. KeyOps approval required within 48h.
Aria: Remediation sequence (short):
```
for r in $(cat claims.txt); do
  echo "snapshot grants for $r"
  KIDS=$(./tools/list_keys_for_role $r)
  for K in $KIDS; do
    aws kms list-grants --key-id $K --query "Grants[?GranteePrincipal=='arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/$r']" > /tmp/$r-$K-grants.json
    aws s3 cp /tmp/$r-$K-grants.json s3://sec-evidence/admin-claim-scrub/SEC-410/
  done
  ./tools/find_cross_bindings --role $r > /tmp/$r-bindings.txt
  tag: aws iam tag-role --role-name $r --tags Key=claim-scrub,Value=pending
  notify owner with evidence links
done
```
Ben: What's the contested-removal window?
Aria: contested -> 24h hold + ping #eng-security-oncall + SecLead. forced removal only after signed approval.
Legal: Confirmed: keep email headers and the exact IAM change payloads. redact customer PII before upload.
KeyBot: SEC-410 updated: grants_snapshot_manifest.csv and notify_log.txt uploaded.
Ramal: Implementation note: prefer `RevokeGrant` not `DisableKey` unless authorized. record API payload and response in ticket.
Kai: I'll run the cross-binding pass later today and post results.
Ben: i'll template the notify message and zap it to owners with evidence placeholders. include manager cc for humans.
Aria: Great. Please watch for false positives and mark them in-thread. we'll reconvene mid-sprint in #eng-security. :white_check_mark:
Legal: will provide redaction checklist.
AuditBot: SEC-410 closed for comments; reopen if further artifacts added.
